note: GLOBAL theme contract. Shared by ClickUp HTML apps (Pages-hosted, resolve live) AND FileMaker layout renders (local design mockups, tokens inlined at render time). One vocabulary, one source of truth. Change a theme file once and every consumer that references its slug reskins.

tokenRoles.surface-1: raised chrome: top/bottom bars, part-header, nav
tokenRoles.accent-2: secondary accent, highlighted titles, focus ring
tokenRoles.on-accent: text/icon sitting on an accent fill

accentBoardRule: ⚠️ THE ACCENT COLUMN IS A SINGULAR-USE VALUE BEING USED PLURALLY, AND THAT IS A MEASURED FAILURE MODE (2026-08-01). `accent` is the actionable colour inside ONE theme, where nothing competes with it — so eleven of them can be individually correct and collectively unreadable. On 08-01 Ferrari, Red Bull, Audi and Haas sat within 1.1 hue degrees and 0.011 lightness of each other, two byte-identical, and it was invisible until an app rendered all eleven at once. The F1 block now holds ONE HUE FAMILY PER TEAM. If you add or edit a row, check its accent against every other row in oklch, not by eye.

fmpRoleMap.note: How the retired FileMaker cv-* layout roles map onto the global contract, for native FMP theme building and render aliasing (resolve.js aliasMap).

themes.name: Default Theme
themes.intendedUse: unskinned default — new apps point here until a theme is chosen

themes.name: Paddock Violet
themes.intendedUse: data-dense motorsport chrome — the f1-racetracks app identity (hue 268 violet ground, F1 mark red as the action accent). An APP palette, not a constructor, which is why it is not in the F1 group.

themes.name: McLaren
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns PAPAYA on the board

themes.name: Ferrari
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns RED on the board, the oldest claim in the sport

themes.name: Red Bull Racing
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns YELLOW (the sun on the can). Moved off red 2026-08-01; the red is now accent-2.

themes.name: Alpine
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns PINK. accent/accent-2 swapped 2026-08-01 so the row states the identity J15 already ruled, instead of every consumer keeping a local swap.

themes.name: Aston Martin
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns BRITISH RACING GREEN. Pushed off Mercedes' teal 2026-08-01 (they were 5.6 hue degrees apart).

themes.name: Audi
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns TITANIUM, the third colour of the 2026 livery and the colour of the rings. Moved off red 2026-08-01; the Audi red is now accent-2.

themes.name: Haas
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns CARMINE, the board's second and last red, deliberately deeper and cooler than Ferrari's scarlet.

themes.name: Racing Bulls
themes.intendedUse: data-dense / ledger — owns INDIGO. ⚠️ 16 hue degrees from Williams' blue, the tightest remaining pair; pre-existing, left alone on purpose, and the next thing to fix if the matrix reads muddy.
